headerTemplate:
cat > "$HOME/coop-setup.sh" <<'COOP_SETUP_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ==============================
@@TITLE@@
# Read it first, then run it. Safe to re-run: finished steps are skipped.
#
# It will:
@@STEP1@@
#   2. Download the latest Co-op client + Windows dedicated server from the
#      official GitHub release and verify their SHA-256 checksums (~4.5 GB).
#   3. Unpack them under ~/Games/BannerlordCoop and write start-server.sh.
@@STEP4@@
# It will NOT: log in to Steam, buy/install Bannerlord, accept the EULA for you,
# enable the mod, touch your router, or start the server.
#
# Options (environment variables):
#   COOP_VERSION=v0.1.7   pin a release (default: latest)
#   COOP_DIR=/path        install folder (default: ~/Games/BannerlordCoop)
#   COOP_YES=1            do not ask for confirmation
# ==============================
set -euo pipefail

COOP_DIR="${COOP_DIR:-$HOME/Games/BannerlordCoop}"
SERVER_DIR="$COOP_DIR/server"
say()  { printf '\n==> %s\n' "$*"; }
note() { printf '    %s\n' "$*"; }
die()  { printf '\nERROR: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
have() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; }
confirm() {
  [ "${COOP_YES:-0}" = 1 ] && return 0
  [ -r /dev/tty ] || die "No terminal to ask on. Re-run with COOP_YES=1 to continue without asking."
  local a; read -r -p "$1 [y/N] " a </dev/tty; case "$a" in y|Y|yes|YES) return 0 ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
}
# sudo only for the few steps that change the system
as_root() { if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then "$@"; elif have sudo; then sudo "$@"; else die "sudo is required for: $*"; fi; }

checks.ubuntu:
# ---- 1. checks --------------------------------------------------------------
if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] && [ "${COOP_ALLOW_ROOT:-0}" != 1 ]; then
  die "Run this as your normal user (it uses sudo only where needed). Steam and Proton must not run as root."
fi
[ -r /etc/os-release ] && . /etc/os-release
case " ${ID:-} ${ID_LIKE:-} " in *" ubuntu "*) ;; *)
  note "This script is written for Ubuntu but this looks like: ${PRETTY_NAME:-unknown}."
  confirm "Run it anyway?" || die "Cancelled. Nothing was changed."
  ;; esac
if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -fsSI --max-time 15 https://api.github.com >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "Cannot reach api.github.com. Check your network and try again."
fi
mkdir -p "$COOP_DIR"
read -r _ _ _ FREE_KB _ < <(df -Pk "$COOP_DIR" | tail -n 1)
if [ "${FREE_KB:-0}" -lt 15000000 ]; then
  note "Only $((FREE_KB / 1048576)) GB free in $COOP_DIR; the server archive needs about 15 GB while unpacking."
  confirm "Continue anyway?" || die "Not enough free disk space."
fi
echo "Detected: ${PRETTY_NAME:-unknown Linux}."
echo "Install folder: $COOP_DIR"
note "Will run with sudo: apt update, install curl p7zip-full iproute2 python3 steam-installer (adds multiverse + i386 if needed)."
confirm "Continue?" || die "Cancelled. Nothing was changed."

tools.ubuntu:
# ---- tools + Steam -----------------------------------------------------------
say "Installing tools (sudo)"
as_root apt-get update
as_root apt-get install -y curl ca-certificates p7zip-full iproute2 python3
if have steam; then note "Steam is already installed."; else
  say "Installing Steam (multiverse + i386, sudo)"
  as_root dpkg --add-architecture i386
  if ! grep -rqs 'multiverse' /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/; then
    as_root apt-get install -y software-properties-common
    as_root add-apt-repository -y multiverse
  fi
  as_root apt-get update
  as_root apt-get install -y steam-installer
fi
tools.debian:
# ---- tools + Steam -----------------------------------------------------------
say "Installing tools (sudo)"
as_root apt-get update
as_root apt-get install -y curl ca-certificates p7zip-full iproute2 python3
if have steam; then note "Steam is already installed."; else
  say "Installing Steam (contrib + non-free + i386, sudo)"
  as_root dpkg --add-architecture i386
  if ! grep -rqsE '(^|[ :])contrib( |$)' /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/; then
    for f in /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*.sources; do
      [ -f "$f" ] || continue
      as_root sed -i -E 's/^(Components:.* main)( .*)?$/\1 contrib non-free\2/; s/^(deb .* main)( .*)?$/\1 contrib non-free\2/' "$f"
    done
  fi
  as_root apt-get update
  as_root apt-get install -y steam-installer
fi
tools.fedora:
# ---- tools + Steam -----------------------------------------------------------
say "Installing tools (sudo)"
as_root dnf install -y curl python3 iproute
as_root dnf install -y 7zip || as_root dnf install -y p7zip p7zip-plugins
if have steam; then note "Steam is already installed."; else
  say "Installing Steam from RPM Fusion (sudo)"
  FEDORA_VER="$(rpm -E %fedora)"
  rpm -q rpmfusion-free-release >/dev/null 2>&1 || as_root dnf install -y "https://mirrors.rpmfusion.org/free/fedora/rpmfusion-free-release-${FEDORA_VER}.noarch.rpm"
  rpm -q rpmfusion-nonfree-release >/dev/null 2>&1 || as_root dnf install -y "https://mirrors.rpmfusion.org/nonfree/fedora/rpmfusion-nonfree-release-${FEDORA_VER}.noarch.rpm"
  as_root dnf install -y steam
fi
tools.arch:
# ---- tools + Steam -----------------------------------------------------------
say "Installing tools (sudo) - pacman will ask you to confirm"
as_root pacman -Syu --needed curl 7zip python iproute2
if have steam; then note "Steam is already installed."; else
  say "Installing Steam (multilib, sudo)"
  if ! grep -q '^\[multilib\]' /etc/pacman.conf; then
    as_root sed -i '/^#\[multilib\]/{s/^#//;n;s/^#//}' /etc/pacman.conf
    grep -q '^\[multilib\]' /etc/pacman.conf || printf '\n[multilib]\nInclude = /etc/pacman.d/mirrorlist\n' | as_root tee -a /etc/pacman.conf >/dev/null
  fi
  as_root pacman -Syu --needed steam
fi
tools.suse:
# ---- tools + Steam -----------------------------------------------------------
say "Installing tools (sudo)"
as_root zypper --non-interactive refresh
as_root zypper --non-interactive install curl python3 iproute2
as_root zypper --non-interactive install 7zip || as_root zypper --non-interactive install p7zip-full
if have steam; then note "Steam is already installed."; else
  say "Installing Steam (non-OSS repository, sudo)"
  for r in repo-non-oss openSUSE:repo-non-oss; do as_root zypper --non-interactive modifyrepo --enable "$r" 2>/dev/null || true; done
  as_root zypper --non-interactive refresh
  if ! as_root zypper --non-interactive install steam; then
    note "No 'steam' package for this openSUSE release - using Flatpak Steam instead."
    have flatpak || as_root zypper --non-interactive install flatpak
    flatpak remote-add --user --if-not-exists flathub https://dl.flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo
    flatpak install --user -y flathub com.valvesoftware.Steam
  fi
fi
tools.bazzite:
# ---- tools + Steam -----------------------------------------------------------
for t in curl python3 sha256sum; do have "$t" || die "$t is missing; install it in a Distrobox container or ask for help."; done
if have steam; then note "Steam found: $(command -v steam)"
elif have flatpak; then
  say "Steam not found - installing Flatpak Steam for your user"
  flatpak remote-add --user --if-not-exists flathub https://dl.flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo
  flatpak install --user -y flathub com.valvesoftware.Steam
else note "Steam not found. Bazzite normally ships it; otherwise install it from the Bazzite store."; fi
tools.deck:
# ---- tools + Steam -----------------------------------------------------------
for t in curl python3 sha256sum; do have "$t" || die "$t is missing."; done
if have steam; then note "Steam found: $(command -v steam)"; else note "Steam not found; on a Deck it is preinstalled. Use Desktop Mode."; fi
tools.nix:
# ---- tools + Steam -----------------------------------------------------------
if [ -z "${COOP_IN_NIX:-}" ]; then
  have nix-shell || die "nix-shell not found."
  say "Re-running inside nix-shell (curl, 7zz, python3, iproute2)"
  COOP_IN_NIX=1 COOP_YES=1 exec nix-shell -p curl _7zz python3 iproute2 coreutils gnugrep findutils --run "bash '$0'"
fi
have steam || note "Steam is not installed. Add  programs.steam.enable = true;  to configuration.nix, then: sudo nixos-rebuild switch"
tools.other:
# ---- tools + Steam -----------------------------------------------------------
for t in curl python3 sha256sum tar xz; do have "$t" || die "$t is required. Install it with your package manager and run the script again."; done
if have steam; then note "Steam found: $(command -v steam)"
elif have flatpak; then
  say "Steam not found - installing Flatpak Steam for your user"
  flatpak remote-add --user --if-not-exists flathub https://dl.flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo
  flatpak install --user -y flathub com.valvesoftware.Steam
else note "Steam not found. Install Steam with your package manager or from Flathub (com.valvesoftware.Steam)."; fi

seven.ubuntu:
# ---- 2. 7-Zip (needed for the server archive) -------------------------------
SEVENZ=""
find_7z() { SEVENZ=""; for c in 7zz 7z 7za; do if have "$c"; then SEVENZ="$c"; return 0; fi; done; return 1; }
find_7z || die "7-Zip (7z) is missing after install."

# ---- 2. 7-Zip (needed for the server archive) -------------------------------

find_7z || die "7-Zip is missing after install."
seven.bazzite:
# ---- 2. 7-Zip (needed for the server archive) -------------------------------
SEVENZ=""
find_7z() { SEVENZ=""; for c in 7zz 7z 7za; do if have "$c"; then SEVENZ="$c"; return 0; fi; done; return 1; }
install_7z_user() {  # official 7-Zip release from github.com/ip7z/7zip, SHA-256 checked, installed into ~/.local/bin
  mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
  local info; info="$(python3 - <<'PY'
import json, re, urllib.request
req = urllib.request.Request("https://api.github.com/repos/ip7z/7zip/releases/latest", headers={"User-Agent": "coop-linux-guide"})
rel = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60))
for a in rel["assets"]:
    if re.fullmatch(r"7z\d+-linux-x64\.tar\.xz", a["name"]) and (a.get("digest") or "").startswith("sha256:"):
        print(a["browser_download_url"], a["digest"][7:]); break
PY
)"
  [ -n "$info" ] || die "Could not find the official 7-Zip download."
  local url sha t; url="${info% *}"; sha="${info#* }"; t="$(mktemp -d)"
  curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$t/7z.tar.xz" "$url"
  printf '%s  %s\n' "$sha" "$t/7z.tar.xz" | sha256sum --check --status || die "7-Zip checksum mismatch."
  tar -xJf "$t/7z.tar.xz" -C "$t" 7zz && install -m 755 "$t/7zz" "$HOME/.local/bin/7zz"
  rm -rf "$t"
}
case ":$PATH:" in *":$HOME/.local/bin:"*) ;; *) export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" ;; esac
find_7z || { say "Installing 7-Zip for your user (no root)"; install_7z_user; find_7z || die "7-Zip install failed."; }
note "7-Zip: $SEVENZ"
seven.nix:
# ---- 2. 7-Zip (needed for the server archive) -------------------------------
SEVENZ=""
find_7z() { SEVENZ=""; for c in 7zz 7z 7za; do if have "$c"; then SEVENZ="$c"; return 0; fi; done; return 1; }
find_7z || die "7zz is missing."

unpack:
# ---- 4. unpack ---------------------------------------------------------------
say "Unpacking into $COOP_DIR"
if [ ! -f "$COOP_DIR/client-module/Coop/SubModule.xml" ]; then
  python3 - "$COOP_DIR/downloads/$CLIENT_NAME" "$COOP_DIR" <<'PY' || die "The client archive is not what we expected."
import os, shutil, sys, zipfile
zpath, root = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
tmp, dest = os.path.join(root, "client-module.tmp"), os.path.join(root, "client-module", "Coop")
shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
zipfile.ZipFile(zpath).extractall(tmp)
hits = [d for d, _, files in os.walk(tmp) if "SubModule.xml" in files]
if not hits:
    sys.exit("no SubModule.xml in the client archive")
shutil.rmtree(os.path.join(root, "client-module"), ignore_errors=True)
shutil.copytree(sorted(hits, key=len)[0], dest)
shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
PY
fi
note "Client module: $COOP_DIR/client-module/Coop"
if [ "${COOP_SKIP_SERVER:-0}" = 1 ]; then
  note "COOP_SKIP_SERVER=1: server archive skipped."
elif [ ! -f "$SERVER_DIR/BannerlordCoopServer.exe" ]; then
  find_7z || die "7-Zip is missing."
  rm -rf "$SERVER_DIR.tmp"; mkdir -p "$SERVER_DIR.tmp"
  "$SEVENZ" x -y -bso0 -bsp0 "-o$SERVER_DIR.tmp" "$COOP_DIR/downloads/$SERVER_NAME"
  [ -f "$SERVER_DIR.tmp/BannerlordCoopServer.exe" ] || die "BannerlordCoopServer.exe not found after unpacking."
  rm -rf "$SERVER_DIR"; mv "$SERVER_DIR.tmp" "$SERVER_DIR"
fi
[ -f "$SERVER_DIR/BannerlordCoopServer.exe" ] && note "Server: $SERVER_DIR" || true
printf '%s\n' "$TAG" > "$COOP_DIR/RESOLVED_VERSION.txt"
launcher:
# ---- 5. launcher (finds Steam + Proton when you run it) ------------------------
cat > "$COOP_DIR/start-server.sh" <<'LAUNCH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Starts the Co-op dedicated server under Proton. Run it from a terminal: the first start asks you to accept the EULA.
set -euo pipefail
COOP_HOME="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
SERVER_DIR="$COOP_HOME/server"
DATA_DIR="$COOP_HOME/server-data"   # config, saves and logs live here (not inside the Proton prefix)
for d in "$HOME/.local/share/Steam" "$HOME/.steam/steam" "$HOME/.var/app/com.valvesoftware.Steam/.local/share/Steam"; do
  [ -d "$d/steamapps" ] && STEAMROOT="$d" && break
done
: "${STEAMROOT:?Steam library not found. Start Steam once and install Bannerlord, then try again.}"
PROTON="${PROTON:-$(ls -d "$STEAMROOT"/compatibilitytools.d/*/proton "$STEAMROOT"/steamapps/common/Proton*/proton 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -n 1 || true)}"
: "${PROTON:?No Proton found. In Steam: Settings > Compatibility (or install Proton-GE), or set PROTON=/path/to/proton.}"
export STEAM_COMPAT_CLIENT_INSTALL_PATH="$STEAMROOT" STEAM_COMPAT_DATA_PATH="$STEAMROOT/steamapps/compatdata/261550"
export STEAM_COMPAT_APP_ID=261550 SteamAppId=261550 SteamGameId=261550
unset PROTON_ENABLE_WAYLAND
mkdir -p "$STEAM_COMPAT_DATA_PATH" "$DATA_DIR"
cd "$SERVER_DIR"
exec "$PROTON" run "$SERVER_DIR/BannerlordCoopServer.exe" --data-dir "Z:$DATA_DIR" --no-watchdog "$@"
LAUNCH
chmod +x "$COOP_DIR/start-server.sh"
note "Launcher: $COOP_DIR/start-server.sh"

firewall.ubuntu:
# ---- 6. firewall ---------------------------------------------------------------
FW_DONE=0
if have ufw && as_root ufw status 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^Status: active'; then
  say "Firewall: ufw is active - allowing UDP 4200-4201"
  as_root ufw allow 4200:4201/udp comment 'Bannerlord Co-op' && FW_DONE=1
elif have firewall-cmd && as_root firewall-cmd --state >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  say "Firewall: firewalld is running - allowing UDP 4200-4201"
  as_root firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=4200-4201/udp && as_root firewall-cmd --reload && FW_DONE=1
fi
[ "$FW_DONE" = 1 ] || note "No active ufw/firewalld found: nothing to open here (check your cloud or router firewall)."
firewall.fedora:
# ---- 6. firewall ---------------------------------------------------------------
FW_DONE=0
if have firewall-cmd && as_root firewall-cmd --state >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  say "Firewall: firewalld is running - allowing UDP 4200-4201"
  as_root firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=4200-4201/udp && as_root firewall-cmd --reload && FW_DONE=1
fi
[ "$FW_DONE" = 1 ] || note "No active firewalld found: nothing to open here (check your router or cloud firewall)."
firewall.deck:
# ---- 6. firewall ---------------------------------------------------------------
say "Firewall"
note "Not changed (this system's firewall is not managed by this script)."
note "If you run one: allow UDP 4200-4201 (ufw: 'ufw allow 4200:4201/udp'; firewalld: 'firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=4200-4201/udp')."
firewall.nix:
# ---- 6. firewall ---------------------------------------------------------------
say "Firewall"
note "NixOS firewall rules are declarative. Add this to configuration.nix, then run: sudo nixos-rebuild switch"
note '  networking.firewall.allowedUDPPortRanges = [ { from = 4200; to = 4201; } ];'

summary.ubuntu:
# ---- 7. summary -----------------------------------------------------------------
GAME_MODULES=""
for d in "$HOME/.local/share/Steam" "$HOME/.steam/steam" "$HOME/.var/app/com.valvesoftware.Steam/.local/share/Steam"; do
  [ -d "$d/steamapps/common/Mount & Blade II Bannerlord/Modules" ] && GAME_MODULES="$d/steamapps/common/Mount & Blade II Bannerlord/Modules" && break
done
say "Done. Co-op $TAG is ready in $COOP_DIR"
cat <<SUMMARY

Still to do by hand (the script cannot do these for you):
  1. Steam: log in, own Bannerlord, install it, and run it once so Proton creates its prefix.
  2. Mod: enable Co-op in the Bannerlord launcher - subscribe on the Steam Workshop (official), or copy
     $COOP_DIR/client-module/Coop into ${GAME_MODULES:-"<Bannerlord folder>/Modules"}/ (same release $TAG for every player).
  3. First server start: run  $COOP_DIR/start-server.sh  in a terminal, read the EULA and answer yourself.
     Then stop it, edit $COOP_DIR/server-data/server-config.json (port, password, saveName) and start it again.
  4. Router: forward UDP 4200-4201 to this PC if players join over the internet (CGNAT can block this).
  5. Check the log shows a "[DedicatedServer] SERVING" line - an open port alone is not proof.

SUMMARY
COOP_SETUP_EOF
bash "$HOME/coop-setup.sh"
